Here’s how to do this in the Chase mobile app, plus wording you can use.

1) Get to the Best Buy transactions  
1. Open the Chase app and sign in.  
2. Tap your **Visa credit card** (your “main” card) from the accounts list.  
3. Scroll through **Activity** to find the **two Best Buy charges for $249.99 on November 2**.  
4. Tap **one** of the two Best Buy transactions (it doesn’t matter which first; you’ll indicate it’s a duplicate of the other).

2) Start the dispute in the app  
On the transaction detail screen, look for one of the following (wording can vary slightly by version):  
- **“Dispute transaction”**, or  
- **“Something wrong with this transaction?”**, or  
- A **“Need help?” / “Help with this charge”** link.

Tap that option.

- **“I was charged more than once for the same purchase”**  
or  
- **“Duplicate charge”** / **“Charged twice”** / **“Billing error – duplicate”**  

If they ask you to **select the matching transaction**, pick the **other Best Buy $249.99 charge on November 2** as the “original” and mark the one you’re on as the **duplicate**.

> “I am disputing a duplicate charge from Best Buy. On November 2, I was charged **twice** for the same purchase for **$249.99**. I **only made one purchase** and received the items once. > “I have a receipt/order confirmation that shows only one purchase. Please contact me if you need a copy.”
